stances.summary: AI bubble will collapse when venture funding dries up, exposing market concentration dangers
stances.quote:
The AI bubble will survive right until it doesn't - and that moment will be when the money stops flowing, and the dangers posed by this circular dealing and market concentration are exposed.

stances.summary: Chip sales artificially inflated by AI labs' compute spending, masking weak underlying demand
stances.quote:
While Broadcom and NVIDIA talk a big game about "demand for AI," their chip sales are really a proxy for OpenAI and Anthropic's compute, who are used to pump up the backlogs of neoclouds with contracts they can't afford to create an illusion of AI demand.
www.wheresyoured.at/conc

stances.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic face unsustainable multi-billion-dollar annual compute commitments
stances.quote:
While we don't know when Anthropic's $517bn in commitments commence, we do know OpenAI plans to spend $750bn through 2030. This means that it likely has hundreds of billions of dollars of compute commitments due every year for the next three years.
www.wheresyoured.at/concentrati

stances.summary: AI compute commitments create obvious 2027 financial wall, more visible than 2007 housing crisis
stances.quote:
The big difference between the 2007 reset wall and the 2027 wall of compute commitments is that AI's version is way, way more obvious, with the tech media reporting them for years. There has never been any way for OpenAI or Anthropic to afford $1.3 trillion.
www.wheresyoured.at/c

stances.summary: AI funding structure mirrors subprime ARMs, with payment shock arriving in 2027
stances.quote:
In the GFC, things looked fine until we hit the 2007 "reset wall" when teaser rates ended and tens of billions of dollars' worth of payments were added to borrowers' mortgages.
From 2027 onward, the same thing happens with Anthropic and OpenAI's compute.
www.wheresyoured.at/conce

stances.summary: AI industry repeating GFC denial pattern, dismissing warnings about unsustainable commitments
stances.quote:
When people raised fears around subprime loans in 2008, they were dismissed as overly-bearish, with defenders saying that ARMs could be refinanced and houses would only ever appreciate.
We're repeating the cycle with OpenAI, Anthropic and AI compute.
www.wheresyoured.at/concentra

stances.summary: OpenAI and Anthropic locked into take-or-pay compute deals with massive 2027 payments due
stances.quote:
Like subprime loans from the GFC where borrowers had a "teaser rate" before their payments shot up, OpenAI and Anthropic have signed massive commitments with low upfront payments. The "teaser rate" period ends in 2027 with an estimated $200bn+ in payments due.
www.wheresyoured.at

stances.summary: AI labs cannot afford $1.3 trillion in committed compute spending starting 2027
stances.quote:
Anthropic and OpenAI's $1.3tr in compute commitments are "take-or-pay," meaning, regardless of demand or cashflow, they'll be on the hook for hundreds of billions of dollars of compute they cannot afford to pay for.
The bill starts coming due in 2027.
www.wheresyoured.at/concentr

stances.summary: AI startups are primary enterprise customers of OpenAI/Anthropic, most dependent on VC funding
stances.quote:
The tech industry, per Ramp, is the only real big spender on AI, with most of that coming from AI startups that can't survive without VC.
In other words, a majority of OpenAI and Anthropic's enterprise revenue comes from companies that can't afford it.
www.wheresyoured.at/concent

stances.summary: AI startups represent billions in revenues for AI labs despite being unsustainable businesses
stances.quote:
These unsustainable AI startups represent a material and existential amount of Anthropic and OpenAI's enterprise revenues. Cursor, for example, was expected to be $1 billion of OpenAI's 2026 revenues - and likely represents billions of Anthropic's too.
www.wheresyoured.at/concent

stances.summary: AI startups are NINJA borrowers of AI era, unprofitable and artificially inflated by easy money
stances.quote:
AI startups are the subprime NINJA borrowers (No Income No Job Applicant) of the AI bubble - unsustainable and unprofitable businesses with tiny revenues that would never have been able to raise money outside of an era of easy money and manic hype.
www.wheresyoured.at/concentrati

stances.summary: AI labs depend on tiny customer base, with unsustainable startups artificially pumping revenues
stances.quote:
OpenAI and Anthropic are the poster children of concentration risk, with 1% of customers providing 80% of revenues, with a large chunk of that coming from unsustainable AI startups subsidizing their users' token spend, artificially pumping revenues.
www.wheresyoured.at/concentrat

stances.summary: Criticizes mainstream media for protecting power structures and repeating official narratives
stances.quote: Sadly there are large parts of the mainstream media that will coalesce to protect the system and repeat whatever the powerful says as gospel, and the only way to stop this from happening is to actually call them out by name again and again

stances.summary: Media failed to scrutinize AI, now seeking to cover consequences
stances.quote:
Though the media largely failed to scrutinize generative AI during its ascent, it now smells blood and is ready to pounce. The problem is, asking whether we're in an AI bubble doesn't really matter if we don't discuss the consequences.
